title: Grilled Salmon Kebabs with Teriyaki Sauce
description: A Japanese-inspired recipe featuring fresh salmon, grilled to perfection and served with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, and teriyaki sauce.
3. Place salmon fillets in a shallow dish and brush with marinade.
4. Thread salmon onto bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush grill with sesame oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill salmon for 4-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. While salmon is cooking, heat teriyaki sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
8. Serve grilled salmon with teriyaki sauce spooned over the top.
9. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.
